apps_lead: Imbuga washyizeho nka porogaramu. Buri yose ifunguka mu idirishya ryayo kandi iguma yinjiye ukoresheje konti zawe za Vizulla.
apps_remove_body: Porogaramu n’akarango kayo bivanwa kuri iyi mudasobwa. Amakuru yawe ku rubuga no kwinjira kwawe birasigara.
apps_empty_body: Imbuga nyinshi zikora nka porogaramu: idirishya ryazo, akarango kazo, ukanda rimwe gusa. Iyo urubuga rushobora gushyirwaho, buto ya Shyiraho igaragara mu mwanya wa aderesi.
apps_step_2: Kanda Shyiraho mu mwanya wa aderesi.
set_site_colors_desc: Amatabu n’umurongo w’ibikoresho bifata ibara rya buri rubuga, nko kuri telefone. Iyo ridahari, biba umweru mu nsanganyamatsiko y’urumuri n’umukara mu y’umwijima.
google_signin_desc: Koresha konti zawe za Google na Gemini uhereye ku mwanya w’ibikoresho.
set_google_accounts: Erekana konti za Google muri menu ya porofayili
set_google_accounts_desc: Yerekana konti za Google winjiyemo ku rubuga kugira ngo uhindure hagati yazo. Vizulla ibaza Google gusa umaze kwinjira ku rubuga rwa Google.
set_gemini_button_desc: Ifungura Gemini iruhande rw’urupapuro, ukoresheje konti wahisemo.
passkey_key_hint: Shyiramo urufunguzo rwawe rw’umutekano hanyuma urukoreho.
passkey_note_mac: Passkey zibitswe muri iCloud Keychain, mu bubiko bw’ijambo ry’ibanga cyangwa kuri telefoni yawe ntiziracyakoreshwa muri Vizulla.
passkey_note_other: Passkey zibitswe kuri telefoni yawe cyangwa mu bubiko bw’ijambo ry’ibanga ntiziracyakoreshwa muri Vizulla.
passkey_note_get: Hitamo Injira mu bundi buryo ukoreshe ijambo ry’ibanga, kode, cyangwa ubutumwa kuri telefoni yawe.
passkey_note_create: Hitamo Ubutaha ukomeze kwinjira nk’uko usanzwe ubikora.
